title: 立上り枠付きドーム型天窓
titleEn: Domed roof skylight with raised curb
description: 屋根に配置する固定式ドーム天窓。丸角長方形の厚み付きドーム、開口を持つ立上り枠と内張り、止水フランジ、連続ガスケット、分割押縁、留めねじ、内側隅補強を造形。ドームは不透明な青灰色の単色PBRで、透過・採光の再現ではありません。屋根本体、開閉機構や通気機能は含みません。水密性・断熱性・荷重・防火・施工・安全基準は未検証です。底面中央の配置原点は実際の屋根勾配・取付面基準とは別で、配置先に合わせて調整してください。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）1.840 × 0.641 × 1.440 m、25,928三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: Fixed rooflight with a thick rounded-rectangular domed shell, genuinely hollow raised curb and liner, weather-flashing flange, continuous gasket, separate retainer bars, fastening screws and internal corner gussets. The dome is an opaque blue-gray constant-color PBR surface, not transparent glazing or a daylight simulation. No roof, opening mechanism or ventilation function is included. Weather sealing, insulation, loading, fire performance, installation and safety standards are unvalidated. The bottom-centered placement origin is separate from the actual roof slope or mounting datum and must be positioned for the target scene. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 1.840 × 0.641 × 1.440 m; 25,928 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
